svg.title: virtio-blk request: 512 bytes at sector 64 of a 64-sector disk
svg.desc: A three-descriptor chain: a readable 16-byte header (type IN, sector 64), a writable 512-byte data buffer and a writable 1-byte status. The walk and rules 1 to 5 pass. Rule 6 fires: 64 × 512 + 512 = 33280, which is more than the disk's 32768 bytes. The device writes status IOERR (1) into the status byte, used length 1, and never touches the disk file.
svg.text: One request, three descriptors, a 64-sector (32 KiB) disk
walk passes 3 descriptors, readable before writable
rules 1-5 pass status byte, header, 3 <= 128, IN with writable data, not OUT
Status IOERR (1), used length 1. The disk file is never touched.
With JavaScript on, the lab lets you change every field and descriptor.
